entities.summary: Panteleimon Sklavos, was ordained Metropolitan Archbishop of Vryoula in 2018 by the Ecumenical Patriarch of Constantinople. Prior to that he was the Greek Orthodox auxiliary bishop of Adelaide and then Melbourne, Australia until 1984.
